# **AI that knows (and uses) your design system**

We’re hosting a live session with TJ Pitre, Founder & CEO of Southleft, and expert in AI-Powered Design Systems, to show what happens when you give LLMs the missing ingredient: your design system. With Storybook, MCP, and Claude, you can guide AI to generate UI that matches your production components.

What you’ll learn:

* 

✅ Why today’s AI prototyping tools fall short for dev teams  
✅ How design systems provide the instruction manual AI needs  
✅ A practical workflow to connect your DS to AI with Storybook \+ MCP  
✅ Real-world demos of DS-aware UI generation  
✅ Lessons learned from integrating agents into design system workflows
